readings: Match each QC record (`scanqc`) to its project where `projects.arcregistry` equals `scanqc.arcref`, and drop QC records with no matching project. For each funding source (`fundflux`), with a missing funding source treated as its own group, how many distinct projects have QC records? Show the funding source, the number of such projects, that number as a fraction of the total across all funding sources, and that number divided by the average per funding source, without rounding.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n
  FROM scanqc q
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       n AS project_count,
       n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM g) AS fraction_of_total,
       n * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM g) AS ratio_to_average
FROM g;
